descriptions.value: PostgreSQL Anonymizer doesn't invalidate plans prepared after a rule was added or a role changed. Users using such plans can still see the unmasked data until the end of the session. The problem is resolved in PostgreSQL Anonymizer 3.3.0 and later versions.

descriptions.description: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

assertions.title: PostgreSQL Anonymizer: Cached plans bypass transparent dynamic masking after a role change or a new masking rule

title: PostgreSQL Anonymizer: Cached plans bypass transparent dynamic masking after a role change or a new masking rule

descriptions.value: A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the boa formParentControl deviceName functionality of X2000R (version(s): TOTOLINK-X2000R-Gh-V1.0.0-B20250421.1327). A specially crafted HTTP request can lead to arbitrary code execution. An attacker can make an authenticated HTTP request to trigger this vulnerability.
Server-side request forgery (ssrf) in Data Quality allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.
